description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 21.05.2018 to 27.05.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it creates binding rules for customs procedures and financial calculations.
